name: Skills master-detail shows a seeded skill and the agent it is attached to
description: L02. Loads /skills, opens the seeded skill branch-coverage-gate (Config tab), switches to Preview (the body as the agent receives it) and Stats (attached to Test Quality Reviewer), then follows Open to that agent's Skills tab, where both seeded skills are attached. Read-only: creating, editing, importing and reordering are covered by the RTL tests and server/test/skills.it.test.ts. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB (see e2e/README.md).
